instruction: You are given the complete TurbSim template `/home/user/Desktop/turbsim_base.inp`, OpenFAST base case `/home/user/Desktop/case_turb_base.fst`, InflowWind base `/home/user/Desktop/inflow_turb_base.dat`, and their dependencies. For this task, the OpenFAST executable is `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/openfast` when working on `turbsim_base.inp`. From the command line: 1. Copy the TurbSim template to `/home/user/Desktop/wind_8ms.inp`, retain the supplied seeds, grid, time settings, and IEC turbulence class B, and confirm `URef=8 m/s` and `RefHt=90 m`. Run `turbsim wind_8ms.inp` so TurbSim creates `/home/user/Desktop/wind_8ms.bts`. 2. Create `/home/user/Desktop/case_turb.fst` from the supplied base. Use the supplied InflowWind file with `WindType=3` and `FileName_BTS=wind_8ms.bts`, and run the OpenFAST case for 60 s. 3. Execute the matching snapshot binaries (use full paths if needed) and retain their normal-termination logs. 4. Write `/home/user/Desktop/postprocess.py` to parse the complete `case_turb.out` `GenPwr` series and compute its arithmetic mean and population standard deviation (`ddof=0`). Save `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` as `mean_pwr_kw, std_pwr_kw`. 5. Do not use GUI tools. [Init Package Note] The archive contains only initialization inputs and a complete version-matched dependency closure; generate all result artifacts yourself.
